lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Saturday 2026-09-12.
You cook on Sunday: the plan sets its sessions on those days, and nowhere else.
This window is short: 1 cooking session, no more — two on the same day would only be one.
The plan starts on Saturday, a day earlier: that is the cooking day, and nothing is eaten on it.
Everything is cooked on Saturday, in one go: whatever would not keep in the fridge until the meal goes in the freezer.
One shop, on Saturday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The shared base is vegetarian: that is Maya's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.
Everyone has every one of their meals.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.
I kept the shared meals distinct while using one substantial Saturday cook, so the two-day stretch has variety without extra cooking sessions.

dishes.name: Sunday Garden Frittata
dishes.title: Potato, courgette, spinach and cheddar frittata
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the frittata. Box Georges's shared portion first on clean equipment, close it, then wash the pan, utensils and worktop before the separate breakfast is assembled.
dishes.why: It is warm, savoury and substantial enough for a busy morning.

dishes.name: Berry Yoghurt Oats
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, oats and blueberries
dishes.method: Stir the oats and honey into the yoghurt, then fold through the blueberries. Assemble this only after the shared breakfast has been closed and the equipment has been washed.
dishes.why: It is cool, quick and makes good use of seasonal berries.

dishes.name: Rich Chicken Pasta
dishes.title: Wholewheat pasta with courgette, parmesan and protein
dishes.method: Reheat the shared base and the standard protein box. Box Georges's standard portion first on clean equipment, close it, wash the pan, utensils and worktop, then reheat and close the vegetarian box before Maya's separate lunch is assembled.
dishes.why: It is a rich, reheatable pasta lunch with late-summer courgette.

dishes.name: Lentil Feta Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, rice, feta, cucumber and tomato
dishes.method: Toss the lentils and rice with the olive oil, then top with feta, cucumber and tomato. Assemble it only after the shared lunch has been closed and the equipment has been washed.
dishes.why: It is a filling, fresh bowl that stays practical on a warm September day.

dishes.name: Turkey Polenta Bake
dishes.title: Polenta, tomatoes, peppers, cheddar and protein
dishes.method: Reheat the shared polenta and the standard protein box. Box Georges's standard portion first on clean equipment, close it, wash the pan, utensils and worktop, then reheat and close the vegetarian box before Maya's separate dinner is started.
dishes.why: It is comforting without being heavy, and reheats cleanly for dinner.

dishes.name: Creamy Bean Pasta
dishes.title: Pasta, cannellini beans, cheddar, olive oil and spinach
dishes.method: Toss the pasta and beans with olive oil, fold through the spinach and finish with cheddar. Assemble it only after the shared dinner has been closed and the equipment has been washed.
dishes.why: It is a creamy, substantial vegetarian dinner assembled in minutes.

dishes.name: Potato Egg Shakshuka
dishes.title: Eggs, potatoes, tomatoes, peppers and feta
dishes.method: Reheat the potato and egg shakshuka. Box Georges's shared portion first on clean equipment, close it, then wash the pan, utensils and worktop before the separate breakfast is assembled.
dishes.why: It brings a different flavour and texture to the second morning while remaining easy to reheat.

preparations.title: Potato, courgette and cheddar frittata
preparations.method: Roast the diced potatoes until tender. Soften the onion and courgette in olive oil, combine with the beaten eggs and cheddar, then bake until set and cut into four portions.

preparations.title: Potato, tomato and feta egg bake
preparations.method: Roast the potatoes. Cook the onion, pepper and tomatoes in olive oil, fold through the potatoes, pour over the beaten eggs, scatter with feta and bake until set.

preparations.title: Courgette parmesan pasta base
preparations.method: Cook the pasta until just tender. Fry the courgette in olive oil, add passata, toss with the pasta and finish with parmesan before dividing into four portions.

preparations.title: Roasted chicken portions
preparations.method: Coat the chicken thighs with olive oil, roast until cooked through, rest, slice and divide into three portions.

preparations.title: Crisp tofu portions
preparations.method: Press the tofu, cut it into slabs, brown it in olive oil on both sides and divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Tomato pepper polenta base
preparations.method: Cook the polenta until thick, stir in half the cheddar, roast the tomatoes and pepper in olive oil, fold them through and divide into four portions with the remaining cheddar.

preparations.title: Roasted turkey portions
preparations.method: Coat the turkey with olive oil, roast until cooked through, rest, slice and divide into three portions.

preparations.title: Herbed lentil portions
preparations.method: Simmer the lentils until tender, drain well, stir through olive oil and divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Aubergine feta couscous base
preparations.method: Roast the aubergine and tomatoes in olive oil. Prepare the couscous, fold through the roasted vegetables and feta, then divide into four portions.

preparations.title: Seared beef portions
preparations.method: Sear the beef strips in olive oil in batches so they brown rather than steam, rest briefly and divide into three portions.

preparations.title: Green lentil portions
preparations.method: Simmer the lentils until tender, drain thoroughly, stir through olive oil and divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Cheddar potato and green bean base
preparations.method: Roast the potatoes in olive oil until crisp, steam the green beans, fold them together with cheddar and divide into four portions.

preparations.title: Roasted pork portions
preparations.method: Coat the pork with olive oil, roast until cooked through, rest, slice and divide into three portions.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Wash and chop all vegetables first, start both lentil pots, and heat the oven. Roast the potatoes for the frittata and shakshuka alongside the aubergine, tomatoes, peppers and courgette; cook the polenta and couscous while the trays roast. Cook and portion the chicken, turkey, beef and pork first on clean equipment, then wash the board, knives, pans and worktop before cooking and boxing the tofu and lentils. Boil the pasta, finish the three bases with their cheese, divide every batch into labelled portions, cool them quickly and refrigerate them for Sunday and Monday.
